title: Sequence-Aware Detection of APT Defense Evasion Using Behavioral Correlation (reproducibility artifact)
description: Code and frozen design specification for the paper 'Sequence-Aware Detection of APT Defense Evasion Using Behavioral Correlation'. Decomposed path scoring (sequence alignment, temporal consistency, contextual coupling) over an externally grounded ATT&CK precedence graph, with two host-provenance pipelines, baselines, and bootstrap confidence intervals.
